Container.Name: AutoExtract
Container.Overview: Scans your folders on a schedule and automatically extracts zip, rar, 7z and tar archives into the folder they are in, then extracts any archives found inside those, and cleans up (deletes or moves) the processed archives and junk files such as *.diz. Works one folder at a time, with parallel extraction inside a folder, a live status page, and a settings page for every option. Created entirely by AI (Claude). It has been tested, but not in every situation - do your own due diligence before relying on it with data you cannot replace, and before exposing it to the internet.

Config.Name: Web UI port
Config.Description: Port for the web UI (status + settings).

Config.Name: App data
Config.Description: Container Path must be /data. Settings (settings.json), scan history, logs and the login key are stored here, so they survive updates and restarts.

Config.Name: Folder to scan
Config.Description: Container Path must be /downloads. Host Path = the share on your server to scan, e.g. /mnt/user/downloads. Needs read/write. It is set as the folder to scan from the first start.

Config.Name: Trash folder (optional)
Config.Description: Optional. Container Path must be /trash. If you set a Host Path (e.g. /mnt/user/trash), processed archives and junk files are MOVED here instead of deleted. Must be its own share/folder - not inside the folder to scan, and not a parent of it. Use the same kind of host path as the scan folder (both /mnt/user/... or both /mnt/diskN/...).

Config.Name: Timezone
Config.Description: Used for the times shown in logs.

Config.Name: UI username
Config.Description: Login for the web UI (used only when a password is set).

Config.Name: UI password
Config.Description: Set a password to require a login for the web UI. Strongly recommended.
